svg.text: Physical elements of the vehicle and the connections between them · says what it is built from; what each element must do comes from the logical architecture by allocation
An element that is the physical side of one sub-system is merged and keeps its Nexus-SubSys-DNN ID; one that serves several is physical only, Nexus-Phys-NN. Numbers in brackets are BOM items.
